title: The Visit of the Wise Men and the Flight to Egypt

questions.question: Where was Jesus born, and during whose reign?
options: In Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king
In Nazareth of Galilee in the days of Caesar Augustus
In Jerusalem during the reign of Pilate
In Capernaum in the days of Herod Antipas
questions.correctAnswer: In Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king
questions.explanation: Matthew 2:1 (ESV): "Now after Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king..."

questions.question: Who came from the east to Jerusalem asking about the newborn king?
questions.explanation: Matthew 2:1 (ESV): "...behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem,"

questions.question: What did the wise men see that prompted them to come and worship the King of the Jews?
options: They saw his star when it rose
They saw a vision of angels in the sky
They read a decree from the Emperor
questions.correctAnswer: They saw his star when it rose
questions.explanation: Matthew 2:2 (ESV): "saying, 'Where is he who has been born king of the Jews? For we saw his star when it rose and have come to worship him.'"

questions.question: How did King Herod react when he heard the wise men's question?
options: He was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him
questions.correctAnswer: He was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him
questions.explanation: Matthew 2:3 (ESV): "When Herod the king heard this, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him;"

questions.question: Who did Herod assemble to ask where the Christ was to be born?
options: All the chief priests and scribes of the people
questions.correctAnswer: All the chief priests and scribes of the people
questions.explanation: Matthew 2:4 (ESV): "and assembling all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he inquired of them where the Christ was to be born."

questions.question: The priests and scribes quoted a prophet who wrote, "And you, O Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah; for from you shall come a ruler..." Which prophet were they quoting?
What did Herod secretly ascertain from the wise men?
options: What time the star had appeared
How many soldiers they brought with them
The exact names of Jesus' parents
questions.correctAnswer: What time the star had appeared
questions.explanation: Matthew 2:7 (ESV): "Then Herod summoned the wise men secretly and ascertained from them what time the star had appeared."

questions.question: When the wise men found the child with Mary his mother, what three gifts did they offer Him?
questions.explanation: Matthew 2:11 (ESV): "Then, opening their treasures, they offered him gifts, gold and frankincense and myrrh."

questions.question: Why did the wise men not return to Herod?
options: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they departed to their own country by another way
They lost their way in the desert
They were arrested by Roman soldiers
They decided to stay in Bethlehem
questions.correctAnswer: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they departed to their own country by another way
questions.explanation: Matthew 2:12 (ESV): "And being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they departed to their own country by another way."

questions.question: Where did the angel of the Lord tell Joseph in a dream to flee with the child and His mother?
questions.explanation: Matthew 2:13 (ESV): "Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, 'Rise, take the child and his mother, and flee to Egypt...'"

questions.question: The flight to Egypt fulfilled the prophecy: "Out of Egypt I called my son." Which prophet spoke this?
What did Herod do when he saw that he had been tricked by the wise men?
options: He sent and killed all the male children in Bethlehem and in all that region who were two years old or under
He sent his army to pursue the wise men
He went to Bethlehem to kill the child himself
questions.correctAnswer: He sent and killed all the male children in Bethlehem and in all that region who were two years old or under
questions.explanation: Matthew 2:16 (ESV): "Then Herod, when he saw that he had been tricked by the wise men, became furious, and he sent and killed all the male children in Bethlehem and in all that region who were two years old or under..."

questions.question: The weeping in Ramah (Rachel weeping for her children) fulfilled a prophecy spoken by which prophet?
questions.explanation: Matthew 2:17-18 (ESV): "Then was fulfilled what was spoken by the prophet Jeremiah: 'A voice was heard in Ramah, weeping and loud lamentation, Rachel weeping for her children...'" (Jeremiah 31:15)

questions.question: When Herod died, why did Joseph choose to go to the district of Galilee rather than returning to Judea?
options: Because he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in place of his father Herod, and he was warned in a dream
Because the star led him to Galilee
Because taxation in Judea was too high
Because Mary preferred the climate in Galilee
questions.correctAnswer: Because he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in place of his father Herod, and he was warned in a dream
questions.explanation: Matthew 2:22 (ESV): "But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there, and being warned in a dream he withdrew to the district of Galilee."

questions.question: In what town did Joseph and his family settle in Galilee, fulfilling the prophecy "He shall be called a Nazarene"?
questions.explanation: Matthew 2:23 (ESV): "And he went and lived in a city called Nazareth, so that what was spoken by the prophets might be fulfilled, that he would be called a Nazarene."

key_verse_text: And going into the house, they saw the child with Mary his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Then, opening their treasures, they offered him gifts, gold and frankincense and myrrh.
